visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male customer wearing a green and yellow color-blocked sweater sits at a restaurant table, holding a brown menu. A male waiter with blonde hair, wearing a white shirt and red apron, stands beside him. The background shows a wooden-paneled wall with framed pictures of food under bright, warm indoor lighting. (2) The customer gestures with his left hand while speaking to the waiter, looking slightly entitled. The camera remains in a medium shot, showing a passer-by in the background sitting at another table. (3) A female waitress with light brown hair and a white uniform shirt replaces the waiter. The customer leans in closely towards her, pointing at the menu and gesturing for her to move her face nearer to the book. (4) The blonde waiter reappears suddenly, leaning between the customer and the waitress to look at the menu. He uses hand gestures to mimic the customer's leaning posture. (5) The customer pulls out a smartphone and presents it to the waitress. The blonde waiter quickly grabs the phone, looks at it, and pretends to enter information, while the waitress stands back with a neutral expression.

The music maintains a steady 4/4 rhythm. (3) A female voice enters with a polite greeting, but is interrupted by the customer's voice dropping to a low, suggestive pitch with slow articulation. (4) A sharp 'ding' sound effect punctuates the entry of the blonde waiter. His voice is firm and mocks the customer's previous phrasing.
